candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Gateway and order metrics are healthy, consistent with payment being the localized slow/erroring hop rather than a contradiction.

candidates.statement: Payment service shows elevated latency (p95 1250ms) with payment.authorize traces at 1050ms returning ERROR and 6 downstream_deadline_exceeded 504 warnings, while gateway and order remain healthy (p95 78ms, error_rate 0.0012). This localizes the checkout degradation to payment-side downstream latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record for payment (3 min old) does not by itself establish deployment-caused latency; the specific slow dependency is unidentified.

report.explanation: Payment is the only service with elevated latency and errors (p95 1250ms, authorize ERROR, 504 deadline warnings), while gateway and order are healthy. This supports a bounded downstream-latency candidate at payment; the exact slow dependency and any deployment causality remain unproven.
